_comment: prism_reservoir/01_single_triangle (2026-09-09): the blazed prism from the STL work moved into an LC reservoir. ONE right triangle, tan(phi)=20/100=0.2 (phi=11.31 deg, same slope as the printed prisms): longer side (base) 15 um along x on the reservoir FLOOR, height 15*0.2=3 um, vertical face at x=15, then 10 um of free LC after it -> reservoir 25 x 15 um. Triangle is an isotropic n=1.5 inclusion (polymer prism) in 5CB; tangent anchoring on all prism edges (LCrelax convention); bulk seed phi=90deg planar (theta=pi/2). LC: Q3D, three-constant 5CB, no E-field (reservoir conventions), planar theta=pi/2 seed. Sources/monitors are simple placeholders (one Ey strip in, 1Ddft out) so the design runs as-is; geometry is the point right now.

polygons._comment: the prism, oriented per the LCrelax single-triangle lineage (example_06 / the original n=1.5-in-LC image): VERTICAL face (height 3) against the LEFT/entrance edge, base 15 along the floor, hypotenuse from (0,3) down to (15,0) — light enters onto the vertical face and exits through the slant. tan(phi)=3/15=0.2. Tangent anchoring on all edges (LCrelax convention).
